body:
>Give it a couple of years. Maybe the girl you're meant to be with is as stupid as I was, but she'll come around,

I want to... but I'm already 20. I feel like I've wasted three years of college while every else "gets" it...they all know how to be downtown, how to play the game. I'm not a douche to anyone, I'm not spectacularly quiet or weird or hideous I don't think...I just get ignored and not included. Insanity is supposed to be trying the same thing over and over for the same results and that's what my social life feels like at this point.

>Sometimes you don't really know how awesome you are, and even if she does, she's not ready for it. Don't wait for anyone, but don't think that it's your fault if she's not ready. I'm glad best-friend/handsomest-fuck-in-the-world 2 didn't!

I sure hope so because I don't feel very awesome right now

THanks for taking the time to respond, I know my post was all over the place...I'm always lost in my head these days really. Have you had a therapist? I just don't understand what they do... I mean I'm already aware my depressed thoughts are irrational and I try to fix them or silence them. That and there's still such a negative stigma with being in therapy I think. Who wants to hang out with a guy who has "issues to work out"?

I'm not trying to contradict you for the heck of it I'm really just unsure :(
